settings.heading: Almost any custom axle for an Australian vehicle

settings.text: We can make almost any custom made axle for a standard Australian vehicle, up to 170 mm flange diameter and 43 mm spline diameter.

We also make custom fully floating axles and drive shaft centre parts for IRS differentials, and can match most braking systems. Years of engineering experience and the splining tools to suit different pressure angles.

settings.title: Splining
settings.text: Splining to different pressure angles, from 12 to 38 splines, plus core splines and custom splines to suit our machinery.

settings.title: Shortening and straightening
settings.text: Axles shortened for a narrowed housing or straightened after damage, then re splined and trued.

settings.title: Stud pattern changes
settings.text: Redrilled or new flanges in the popular Holden, Ford, Nissan, Mazda, Toyota and custom patterns.

settings.title: Full floater axles
settings.text: Custom fully floating axle sets for strength and safety on heavy and competition vehicles.

settings.title: IRS drive shaft centres
settings.text: Drive shaft centre parts made for IRS differentials to suit most braking systems.

settings.title: One off jobs
settings.text: If it is close to a standard Australian axle we can most likely make it. Ask us.
